changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0065. Trainer mobile sessions need a scheduled state before completion, plus the exercise checklist recorded with the session. Index review: PK_PtSessionExercises. FK to PtSessions. IX_PtSessionExercises_Session loads the checklist with the session. IX_PtSessions_TenantId_Trainer_Start serves the trainer schedule. CompletedOn stays nullable until the session is completed; existing completed rows already have a date. Performance note: a trainer schedule reads by tenant, trainer, and start time.
changeSet.sql: IF OBJECT_ID('app.PtSessionExercises', 'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE app.PtSessionExercises ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, PtSessionId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, Name NVARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, MuscleGroup NVARCHAR(80) NULL, Sets INT NOT NULL, Reps NVARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, Completed BIT NOT NULL, SortOrder INT NOT NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, DeletedAt DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, UpdatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, RowVersion ROWVERSION NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_PtSessionExercises PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_PtSessionExercises_Tenants FOREIGN KEY (TenantId) REFERENCES app.Tenants (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_PtSessionExercises_PtSessions FOREIGN KEY (PtSessionId) REFERENCES app.PtSessions (Id), CONSTRAINT CK_PtSessionExercises_Sets CHECK (Sets BETWEEN 1 AND 20) ); CREATE INDEX IX_PtSessionExercises_Session ON app.PtSessionExercises (TenantId, PtSessionId, SortOrder) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL; END IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE name = N'IX_PtSessions_TenantId_Trainer_Start' AND object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'app.PtSessions')) CREATE INDEX IX_PtSessions_TenantId_Trainer_Start ON app.PtSessions (TenantId, TrainerProfileId, ScheduledStartUtc) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL;
